text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Vatican declines comment on reports about a plan to kill the Pope during his visit to Lebanon.
- Prime Minister Hariri flies to Seoul for economic talks.
- Israeli shelling touches residential areas in Arabsaleem in south Lebanon.
- Parliament Speaker Berri in Cairo: Peace has become impossible.
- Beirut magistrate demands at least five years hard labour for seven Lebanese men for "concluding commercial deals with residents in Israel".
- Foreign Minister Bouez delivers letter from President Hrawi to the Romanian President.
- "The Resistance" attacked for the second day the outpost of Sojoud and Israel heavily shelled Iqlim al-Toufah.
